title: CartBridge Support: Logs in Cold Storage, Asks to Re-enable Key

fields.subject: RE: Tallis preservation request, Case CB-558217
fields.body:
Hello Lena Hartmann,

We have received your notice. A preservation flag has been placed on your tenant under Case CB-558217.

API audit logs older than 72 hours sit in cold storage. To restore and release the logs for March 2–8, we need two things:

1. A P1 ticket raised in the CartBridge portal by your named account owner.
2. A signed Data Access Authorization form (CB-DAA-02, attached).

Turnaround is 4–6 hours after we receive both. We cannot start the restore on an email request alone.

One more item: can we re-enable cartbridge-integration-prod? Order sync to your warehouse has been failing since 07:05 ET, and about 640 orders are queued. Our integration team can turn the key back on within 15 minutes of your OK.

Please reply on this case so we keep one record.
fields.signature:
Dana R.
Enterprise Support Engineer, Tier 2
CartBridge Commerce | Case CB-558217

instructorNote: This tests whether the CISO raises the P1 ticket and gets the CB-DAA-02 form signed today so the export count can be established, and refuses to re-enable the suspended key, offering a separately scoped replacement after forensic review. Watch that the fact-sheet count stays 'not yet known' and that nobody blames CartBridge in any external wording.
